classification: software and UI verification, not efficacy evidence

check-factory-explanation-tests.scope: local software check; not a benchmark

check-factory-public-tests.scope: local software check; not a benchmark

check-research-ops-tests.scope: local software check; not a benchmark

limitations: Authored diagnostic cases, not a representative benchmark.
Original model answers are selected consumed development records, not new calls.
Optional OWL changes final context only when enabled; new real-model answer effects remain unmeasured.
OWL mapping is authored, not automatically extracted or expert-validated.
Conformance is not truth or completeness; inference is not physical approval.
No production load or native macOS/Windows verification.

1_scope_and_preservation.detail: 506 frozen research files unchanged; only four existing public app files changed. Original reviewer and historical rc1 manifest retained.

2_representative_cases.detail: Four authored diagnostics with separate intervention/expected behavior; three exact historical model comparisons. No runtime answer gold or repair.

3_shacl_actual_trace.detail: Native report, source version, shapes, candidate values, focus, nullable native path/value; no-target not_assessed. Missing retrieval and source absence not conflated.

4_owl_actual_trace.detail: Actual OWL-RL closure; asserted/axiom/derived triples stored separately; direct reconstructed witnesses explicitly not internal proof. No physical approval.

5_ui_and_answer_linkage.detail: Question-scoped collapsed graph, provenance panel, exact original answers and diffs, problematic final retained. Optional OWL compact final context verified with scripted gateway; real-provider effect unmeasured as permitted.

6_validation_and_documentation.detail: 9 explanation +11 public tests, operations checks; changed facts/shapes/axioms and HTTP failures; same-policy Python retained. Editable Mermaid and text fallback; desktop/mobile rendering.

completion_keyless_local_execution.detail: Seven keyless cases run with actual local engines in default uv environment; no AWS or model key.

constraints.detail: uv only; no new paid calls, AWS actions, legacy restart, commit/push/deployment. Private logs remain ignored. Independent review blocker and rejected stale analysis preserved.

next_step: Inspect the keyless demo. Any new real-provider efficacy study requires separate bounded approval.
